name: RSRC-MVR
flavorText: Ancient skyscraper-sized copper beasts built to haul large amounts of resources across barren wastelands.

name: CK-199 'Woodpecker'
flavorText: Versatile mass produced tank capable of piercing any armor with its up-to-date railgun.

name: CK-102 'GRÜBBENTRAKTOR'
flavorText: Small lightweight tank destroyer designed to crash and infiltrate enemy bases in lethal speeds.

name: WB-110 'Big Ant'
flavorText: The gigantic backbone of the Disobedient Armed Forces. One of these was enough to change the tides of a battlefield.

name: WB-110 Type 2
flavorText: A new prototype of the beloved 'Big Ant' after many have criticized it for not looking like an ant.
